prompt_version: s5-extract-facts-v2 (adapted from Paleo Atlas extract-facts-v3; v2 after Sofía's S5 review)

facts.statement: A 62-year-old man experienced dizziness, slurred speech, and weakness in his left arm over several months.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: Magnetic resonance imaging revealed a mass in the right frontal lobe of his brain.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: Doctors initially suspected the brain mass was a metastasis from a small intestine cancer the man had been treated for eight and a half years earlier.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: A PET/CT scan showed high metabolic activity in the brain tumor but no active cancer in the rest of the body.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: After the tumor was surgically removed, lab tests identified it as a sarcoma, a type of cancer that starts in connective tissue.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: The man received radiation therapy to the brain after the surgery.
facts.subject: humans
